name: smart-campus-canteen
description: Smart Campus Canteen – Zero Queue Food Ordering System

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -p "[{name}]" -n "SERVER,STUDENT,OWNER" -c "yellow.bold,cyan.bold,magenta.bold" "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client" "npm run dev --prefix canteen-owner"
scripts.dev:main: concurrently -k -p "[{name}]" -n "SERVER,CLIENT" -c "yellow.bold,cyan.bold" "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.dev:owner: concurrently -k -p "[{name}]" -n "SERVER,OWNER" -c "yellow.bold,magenta.bold" "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix canteen-owner"
scripts.build:all: npm run build --prefix client && npm run build --prefix canteen-owner
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd server && npm install && cd ../client && npm install && cd ../canteen-owner && npm install
